sources.title: meta-llama-3-8b-instruct: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: meta-llama-3-8b-instruct is a transformer-based instruction-tuned language model with 8 billion parameters. The model supports input sequences up to 8192 tokens and is optimized for dialogue through instruction-tuning on conversational data. The tokenizer is proprietary to Llama 3 and handles the special chat formatting tokens.
